tools.name: aethyn_launch_browser
tools.description: Launch a local Chromium routed through a residential proxy exit in a chosen country (and city/state on the Elite tier). Returns a session_id the other aethyn_* tools use. Each session is one sticky identity — a pinned exit IP for the whole task.

city.description: City for Elite-tier targeting, e.g. 'tokyo'. Requires tier:'elite'.

state.description: State/region for Elite-tier targeting. Requires tier:'elite'.

tier.description: Proxy tier. Elite unlocks city/state targeting. Default 'premium'.

session.description: Your task id. Reuse the same value to pin the same exit IP. Letters/digits/underscore only. Omit to auto-generate.

tools.name: aethyn_navigate
tools.description: Navigate the session's browser to a URL and wait for load. Returns the HTTP status, final URL, and page title — read the page with aethyn_get_content to judge the response yourself. Public data only — respect robots.txt, rate limits, and each site's terms.

tools.name: aethyn_get_content
tools.description: Return the current page's content cleaned for reading (markdown by default). Use after navigating to extract data.

tools.name: aethyn_snapshot
tools.description: Return a structured accessibility snapshot (roles, names, and [ref=..] handles) of the page. Pass those refs to aethyn_click / aethyn_type. No screenshots needed.

tools.name: aethyn_click
tools.description: Click an element. Prefer a 'ref' from aethyn_snapshot (e.g. 'e12'); or pass a 'selector' (CSS, or Playwright role=/text= engine).

tools.name: aethyn_type
tools.description: Type text into an input. Prefer a 'ref' from aethyn_snapshot; or a 'selector'. Set submit:true to press Enter after.

tools.name: aethyn_check_exit_ip
tools.description: Fetch IP info THROUGH the session's proxy so you can verify the exit country/city actually landed before trusting the page. Returns ip, country, city, org/ASN, and a best-effort is_residential flag.

tools.name: aethyn_new_identity
tools.description: Rotate the session to a fresh residential exit (new IP, same country) and clear cookies. Use between independent tasks or after a soft-block.

tools.name: aethyn_close
tools.description: Close the session's browser context and free memory. Call this when a task is done.

tools.name: aethyn_list_countries
tools.description: List available exit countries (and Elite-tier cities where known). Discover geo options at runtime before launching.

with_cities.description: Only return countries that have known cities.
